description:
Problem: when develop's base itself is invalid, no PR can pass a required check. That happened on 2026-10-24 (scope entry naming a missing file). The owner removed tooling from ruleset 15611785 for one merge and restored it. docs/agent/emergency-merge.md (agent evidence-and-stop steps, owner sequence, read-back) and docs/agent/merge-authority.md:102-121 (Bypassing a required check) already exist, but they conflict. AGENTS.md:26 and merge-authority.md:104-112 let an agent relax the ruleset when the owner names the PR; emergency-merge.md:21-27 says agents never do. The read-back command (scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py) compares contexts against the runbook but ignores integration_id (repo-admin-settings.md:281-282), and it cannot prove the ruleset equals its pre-relaxation state. No decision record exists for the 2026-10-24 relaxation, which emergency-merge.md:59-73 requires.

Outcome: a single, consistent owner procedure and a read-back command that proves the live ruleset equals a pre-relaxation capture.

Decision gates:
1. Who may relax. Stop until the owner answers whether an agent may ever perform the one-context relaxation. Recommended: owner-only, matching emergency-merge.md. Then remove the agent bypass procedure from merge-authority.md:102-113 and point it to emergency-merge.md. Change AGENTS.md:26 only with the owner's explicit approval of the new wording.
2. Automatic recovery. Advisor prevention row 2 proposes trusted checker logic that recovers from a paired notice/selector relocation by itself. Default: no. It is new trusted logic, it must be installed before the next incident to help, and the break-glass covers today's frequency. Record the decision and reason in context; if the owner wants it, file a separate item.
3. Comparison source. Extend scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py with a capture-comparison mode rather than adding a parallel script, unless its structure makes that impossible; record why if so.

The procedure, written into emergency-merge.md (agent side) and repo-admin-settings.md (owner steps), covers: one named PR and head SHA; holds on competing armed PRs; a full ruleset JSON capture before the change; removal of exactly one context; the merge; immediate restore on success or failure; a full read-back compared with the capture; and the decision record that emergency-merge.md requires.

Item guardrails: no ruleset edits by agents, including in tests; tests use captured JSON fixtures only.

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, after make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. No SKIP or --no-verify, no stand-in approvals, no ruleset edits or bypasses, no raw gh pr merge. Do not change oracle-gate's App binding (integration 5201041), the oracle decision rule, or the native review-thread-resolution requirement. Do not close and reopen, mass-rerun or rebase other pull requests. No explanatory comments or docstrings in code; commits, PR bodies and docs carry no tracker item IDs or session labels; timing uses benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time().
